outcome: the mean Z scores of birth weight
cohort: 122 hospitalized cases of twin pregnancy complicating preterm birth with gestational weeks from 26 weeks to 36 weeks+6
finding: Compared to singleton pregnancy, twin pregnancy was associated with higher gestational weight gain, prenatal usage rate of glucocorticoids, rate of Cesarean section and incidence of spontaneous preterm labor, as well as lower birth weight and mean Z scores of birth weight in infants, and longer ventilator-usage period and higher rates of respiratory distress syndrome (RDS), pneumonitis, sepsis, hypoglycemia and anemia.
